failed_gates.literal_criterion: relative_discrepancy <= 0.03 AND z <= 4.0, for all 96 theorem-supported cells
failed_gates.detail: 9 t1p5 cells are statistically consistent (|z| 0.35-1.49) but fail a 3% accuracy criterion asked of an estimator whose own relative SE is 1.5%-23.3%. 1 skewnormal4 cell (|z|=4.29) is finite-difference bias on an asymmetric map, resolved by independent adjudication to 0.56 combined SE at a finer step pair.

failed_gates.literal_criterion: relative_discrepancy >= 0.5 AND z >= 10.0, for all 32 outside-assumption cells
failed_gates.detail: The gate tests for a sharp deterministic defect. That is the signature of F1 (moving support) and F1 produces it. It is structurally unreachable for F2 (no first moment), whose proved content is non-existence of the estimand: PROOF.md section 10 proves E|A_1| = infinity, so neither route converges and z cannot grow.

failed_gates.literal_criterion: |P4 - closed| / se_P4 <= 4.0 on the 8 Gaussian frozen cells
failed_gates.detail: The gate divides by P4's standard error alone, treating an uncertified closed Monte Carlo point as exact. The correctly specified two-sample statistic gives worst |z| = 2.9768218705413254 against the same limit of 4. A fresh 1.6M-path run of the frozen P2 implementation itself agrees with P4 within 1.26-1.49 combined SE, identifying the older 240k-path P2 vector as a correlated high Monte Carlo realization.
